subject.title: feat(ui): redesign cron page as sidebar-first Automations master-detail

question: Should Automations be pinned by default only when no valid saved sidebar list exists, while every valid existing list remains unchanged?
rationale: The settings loader cannot distinguish an intentionally minimal saved list from a historical auto-persisted default, so migrating valid lists requires an explicit product policy rather than a mechanical code choice.

options.title: New defaults only
options.body: Apply the Automations pin only to fresh, missing, or invalid preferences and preserve every valid saved list unchanged.

options.title: Migrate a legacy list
options.body: Define a narrowly recognized historical default list and upgrade it, accepting that some intentional matching preferences may change.

options.title: Do not default-pin
options.body: Ship the redesigned page without changing sidebar defaults and leave discovery to More and customization.

recommendation.title: New defaults only
recommendation.body: Apply the Automations pin only to fresh, missing, or invalid preferences and preserve every valid saved list unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history owns the current sidebar grouping/default model and the cron creation experience being replaced.
